checks.name: Transparent checkbox retains its visible associated label
Hidden native select does not erase a visible label and radio affordance
Hidden ancestor and hidden label are not visible affordances
Duplicate labels remain separate and do not imply unique action targets
Observation records disabled state without entering or exposing field values
Read-only field observation neither selects nor clicks controls

limitations: Original fixtures; label visibility does not certify source behavior, unobscured target or complete field discovery
